0.q: How do I place an order?
0.a: Simply browse our collections, add your favorite items to the cart, and proceed to checkout. Follow the instructions to complete your purchase securely.

1.q: What payment methods do you accept?
1.a: Currently we only support pay on delivery.

2.a: Shipping times vary by location, but most orders are delivered within 3-7 business days. You’ll receive a tracking number once your order ships.

3.q: Can I return or exchange an item?
3.a: Yes! If you’re not satisfied, you can return or exchange your item within 14 days of delivery. Please see our Returns Policy for details.

4.q: Are your products authentic and in-house designed?
4.a: Absolutely. All designs are created by our team and produced with premium materials for true basketball fans.

5.a: You can reach us via email at info@trojka.mk or use the contact form on our Contact page. Our team is available 24/7.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.startedText: It all started in 2021, in the slow, quiet hours of the pandemic. A few sketches on paper turned into our first test prints; a handful of tees became a small drop, then a real studio. What pushed us forward wasn’t a business plan — it was love for basketball and a stubborn need to express it our way. We built TROJKA.mk as a space where hoops culture meets design craft, where a creative idea can jump from a notebook to a hoodie you actually want to wear.
ourStory.funText: We design because it’s fun — simple as that. If something makes us laugh, sparks a memory, or nods to a legendary play, it goes on the board. Some ideas land as bold graphics, others as subtle typography or vintage textures. We test, tweak, and ship small batches so every piece feels alive. It’s playful, it’s bold, and it stays unmistakably TROJKA.mk.
ourStory.craftText: Everything is made in-house — from pencil sketch to vector artwork, from color tests to the final print. We obsess over fabrics, fit, and finish, so graphics look fresh on day one and still punch after a hundred washes. We build themed collections alongside daily essentials: T‑shirts, hoodies, and jerseys engineered to feel premium, move well, and last.
ourStory.quality1: Top‑notch materials, heavyweight cotton, and crisp, fade‑resistant prints.
ourStory.quality2: Original collections plus essentials: tees, hoodies, and jerseys in rotating drops.
ourStory.quality3: Built in our local studio for a global hoops culture — shipped with care.

joker.title: The Joker
joker.intro: When Nikola Jokić steps on the court, you never know what’s coming — a no-look pass, a triple-double, or a game-winning smile. That same spirit lives in The Joker Collection, a line of tees and hoodies designed in-house to capture his playful energy and MVP legacy. This is not just fanwear — it’s a creative statement piece built for those who dare to stand out.
joker.unleashText: Every item in this collection tells a story. Bold graphics, oversized fits, and sleek prints are all crafted with a mix of fun and finesse, just like Jokić himself. The designs are born in our studio — exclusive in-house artwork that you won’t find anywhere else. Whether it’s a hoodie with a twist of surreal humor, or a tee that nods to his Serbian roots and larger-than-life personality, the collection brings that Joker unpredictability to your wardrobe.
joker.whyText: This isn’t a random print-on-demand job. Every design is sketched, refined, and finalized by our creative team, making each piece authentically ours. Think playful illustrations, clever typography, and graphics that mix basketball culture with Joker-esque mischief. It’s a combination of street art vibes, premium fashion feel, and pure hoops passion.

materials.durable: Designed to Last → Because like Jokić’s game, style this good doesn’t fade away.

antic.title: Pero Antić
antic.intro: From Skopje courts to NBA spotlights, Pero Antić brought toughness, personality, and a fearless shot. This drop leans into the moment — Pero striding forward while LeBron’s on the deck — not disrespect, just that playful, unstoppable swagger. In-house designs blend Macedonian heritage, bold typography, and a tongue-in-cheek walk-over silhouette. Built for those who carry pride — on and off the court.
antic.designTitle: Design With Heart, Made For Hoops
antic.designText: The graphics lean into Pero’s identity — the eagle, the stripes, the grit — and that iconic walk-over stance. Expect oversized tees, premium hoodies, sharp prints, and funky color pops that nod to the golden years of European hoopers making noise in the league. Every piece is sketched and refined by our team — no copies, no shortcuts, just authentic TROJKA.mk craft.
antic.whyText: Pero Antić isn’t just a name — he’s a mindset. Confidence without compromise. These pieces channel that edge into wearables that feel as strong as they look. For the fans who remember the memes, the moment, and the pride of seeing a Macedonian stand tall — step by step — on the biggest stage.

materials.durable: Made to Last → Because real MVPs don’t fade.

luka.title: Luka Dončić
luka.intro: Lights, camera, step-back. Luka’s game has that blockbuster charm — a mix of craft, calm, and clutch that plays like a highlight reel. The Luka Goes to Hollywood collection blends European finesse with big-screen flair: think film-grain textures, marquee-inspired typography, and TROJKA.mk’s signature gold accents for that premiere-night glow.
luka.journeyTitle: From Ljubljana to the Big Screen
luka.journeyText: Story-driven graphics nod to Luka’s journey — the step-back frame, starlit backdrops, and playful references to scene-stealing moments. Expect oversized tees, premium hoodies, and sharp prints that feel as effortless as his pace control. Designed in-house, crafted to be worn on set or courtside.
luka.actionText: This collection is about cool control — the kind that makes crowds whisper before they roar. Clean silhouettes, vivid prints, and a dash of Hollywood gold bring the spotlight to everyday wear. Authentically TROJKA.mk, made to be rewatched.
